file: 293 This Roblox Game Copied a Game That Isnt Even Out Yet.mp4

lines.t: This Roblox game got over 122 million visits, by copying a game that isn't even out yet.

full.credit: Clips: FoltynPlays; Ready To Wishlist; Navi (YouTube)

lines.t: In August, a video of a game about finding one needle in a haystack got over 50 million views.

full.credit: Clips: FoltynPlays; Ready To Wishlist; Navi (YouTube)

lines.t: The real game still isn't out. But copies showed up right away, on Steam and on Roblox.

full.credit: Clips: FoltynPlays; Ready To Wishlist; Navi (YouTube)

lines.t: Search For The Needle came out on Roblox in August. Now it has over 122 million visits.

full.credit: Clips: FoltynPlays; Ready To Wishlist; Navi (YouTube)

lines.t: It happened before. When PEAK blew up, a Roblox copy called CLIFF got millions of visits. PEAK's devs said they'd rather you pirate their game.

full.credit: Clips: FoltynPlays; Ready To Wishlist; Navi (YouTube)

lines.t: So the real creator made a joke mode: find the original game in a pile of clones.

full.credit: Clips: FoltynPlays; Ready To Wishlist; Navi (YouTube)

lines.t: Is copying a game ever okay?

full.credit: Clips: FoltynPlays; Ready To Wishlist; Navi (YouTube)
